newsitem.title: CANADA: DBRS puts Norcen Energy under review.
newsitem.headline: DBRS puts Norcen Energy under review.

text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service said on Tuesday it put Norcen Energy Resources Ltd under review after Norcen offered to acquire Basic Petroleum International Ltd for US$303 million in cash plus a royalty right.
DBRS said the potential deal would add about C$100 million or about 18 percent to Norcen's annual cash flow.

Also, "it would almost double net debt levels to about C$1 billion, representing close to 40 percent of capitalization, compared to the mid-20 percent range currently, and raise the net debt to cash flow ratio from slightly under one times to about 1.5 times," DBRS said.
Norcen's annual production would rise by 17 percent, it added.
